CFML Language Reference: Functions

DecimalFormat

Returns a number as a string with exactly two decimal places and commas between each group of three digits. It is a quick shorthand for NumberFormat(number, ",.00").

Category

Display and formatting functions

Syntax

DecimalFormat(number)

Parameters

number
The number to format. Values with more than two decimal places are rounded.

Returns

A string such as "1,234,567.89".

Usage

Negative numbers get a leading minus sign. For money, DollarFormat adds a dollar sign and puts negative amounts in parentheses; for any other layout, use NumberFormat with your own mask.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Values = "1234567.891,42,-3,0.005,999.999">
<TABLE BORDER=1 CELLPADDING=3>
<TR><TH>Number</TH><TH>DecimalFormat</TH></TR>
<CFLOOP INDEX="N" LIST="#Values#">
<CFOUTPUT>
<TR><TD>#N#</TD><TD ALIGN="right">#DecimalFormat(N)#</TD></TR>
</CFOUTPUT>
</CFLOOP>
</TABLE>
